programme.desc: In women's tennis, the 2025 season culminated with the WTA Finals in Riyadh with the participation of the eight best players. Each episode of this series will be devoted to a different one. We will see what challenges tennis players and their teams have to face. Cameras accompanied them during their stay in the capital of Saudi Arabia, but they also talked about events from the entire season.
